sentences.text: Mochlodon is a genus of rhabdodontid dinosaurs found in Austria and Hungary.
The genus name Mochlodon refers to a bar-like ridge on the teeth, derived from Greek words for 'bar' and 'tooth'.
The type specimen dates to the Lower Campanian, approximately 80 million years ago.
The dentary bone was designated as the lectotype for Mochlodon in 2005.
Fossils of Mochlodon were first reported in 1859 from the Gute Hoffnung mine in Austria.
Emanuel Bunzel originally described the type species as Iguanodon suessii in 1871.
Harry Govier Seeley established the separate genus Mochlodon in 1881.
A second species, Mochlodon vorosi, was described from Hungary in 2012.
Mochlodon is classified within the family Rhabdodontidae.
Mochlodon lived between 85 and 80 million years ago during the Late Cretaceous in what is now Europe.
The fossil record for Mochlodon spans from the Santonian to the Maastrichtian stages, between 85.7 and 66 million years ago.
A 2026 study concluded that Mochlodon vorosi is a junior synonym of the ceratopsian Ajkaceratops.
A 2005 study suggested the Austrian remains might belong to Zalmoxes because no unique features were found for Mochlodon.
